mappings.rationale: Lampiran 5 (fwd) and Lampiran 10 (rev) both show KBLI-2020 02409 'Jasa Penunjang Kehutanan Lainnya' fanning to two 2025 targets (02401 and 02409), so from the 2020 source's perspective this leg is a SPLIT. Semantically, the surviving 02409-2025 uraian keeps the operational/technical-support slice of the old catch-all: jasa kehutanan (inventarisasi hutan, jasa konsultasi manajemen kehutanan, pengevaluasian kayu, pencegahan kebakaran hutan, pengendalian hama hutan, penyewaan perlengkapan dan peralatan kehutanan dengan operator) plus jasa pemanenan kayu (pengangkutan kayu terasosiasi pemanenan). Crucially, its own 'tidak mencakup' list explicitly excludes pengelolaan air di kawasan hutan and kegiatan penangkapan/penyimpanan karbon — classic forest-ecosystem-services content — which is the substantive (not title-only) signal that this slice of the old 02409 catch-all was carved OUT rather than retained here.

Same 2020 source (02409 'Jasa Penunjang Kehutanan Lainnya') also feeds 2025 code 02401 'Jasa Lingkungan Hutan' — confirmed independently on both the forward table (Lampiran 5, row 02409->02401) and the reverse table (Lampiran 10, row 02401<-02409). Uraian-level support (not title-similarity): 02409-2025's own exclusion list carves out exactly the water-management-in-forest-area and carbon-capture/storage functions that a code titled 'Jasa Lingkungan Hutan' (forest environmental/ecosystem services) would house — evidence that the old 02409-2020 catch-all's environmental-services activities were split off into this newly-distinct 2025 code, separate from the operational-support code that kept the 02409 number.

Lampiran 10 (rev, p.330) shows 2025 code 02409 also drawing from 2020 code 02404 'Jasa Kehutanan Bidang Perencanaan Kehutanan' (forestry planning services) — a second, independent source feeding the same 2025 target, i.e. a MERGE from 02409-2025's perspective. Substantive link (not title match): 02404's subject, forestry planning, corresponds to the 'inventarisasi hutan' and 'jasa konsultasi manajemen kehutanan' activities explicitly enumerated in 02409-2025's own uraian — the former standalone planning-services code's content was absorbed into the broader 'other forestry support services' catch-all rather than surviving as its own 2025 code (no 2025 code titled anything like 'perencanaan kehutanan' exists in this evidence set).

payload.notes:
